What Will You Learn in Selenium Training? Enroll in the Selenium training course at 3RI Technologies to develop practical skills for a career in automation testing. The training covers fundamental as well as advanced Selenium concepts, helping learners strengthen their testing knowledge and gain hands-on experience with automation tools and frameworks. What You Will Learn: Understand Selenium concepts and automation testing practices from the basics. Create, execute, and maintain reusable automation scripts. Improve test execution efficiency and reduce repetitive manual testing efforts. Work with Selenium WebDriver, testing frameworks, and automation workflows. Understand how Selenium can be integrated with CI/CD environments. Build practical projects that strengthen your automation testing portfolio. Develop skills relevant to automation testing and QA job opportunities. Prerequisites for Selenium Testing Course in Pune It is beneficial to have a basic understanding of software testing ideas. Familiarity with programming fundamentals is recommended, preferably Java or Python . Beginners can continually develop their automation skills by starting with the basics. Who Can Enroll for Selenium Training in Pune? The Selenium training in Pune at 3RI Technologies is suitable for students, freshers, manual testers, software testing professionals, QA engineers, working professionals, and candidates looking to transition into automation testing . It is designed for learners who want to strengthen their testing skills through practical, industry-oriented training. Who should Learn Selenium? Anyone wishing to change careers into the automation industry. New hires/college graduates Engineers working on any other automation tool; developers; quality analysts Manual testers; white box testers; user interface testers. Access to resources, documentation, and help is also made possible by its sizable development community. Supports a Variety of Programming Languages: Selenium is compatible with a number of widely used programming languages, including Java, Python, C#, Ruby, JavaScript, and Perl, so developers and testers can select the language that best suits their needs. Operates Across Operating Systems: Selenium may be used in a variety of testing scenarios because it is compatible with the main operating systems, such as Windows, macOS, and Linux. Cross-Browser Testing: Selenium helps testers validate web applications in various browser contexts by supporting popular browsers like Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Safari, and Internet Explorer. Integration with Frameworks and Tools: Selenium can integrate with testing frameworks and build tools such as TestNG, JUnit, Maven, and Jenkins , making it easier to create structured automation workflows and integrate testing into CI/CD pipelines. What do you get after Selenium Certification & Placement Course in Pune We have designed our Selenium Certification and Selenium Training with students’ interests in mind. The following are the benefits of the training: Placement Calls Without Limits Numerous walk-ins Lifetime Assistance Practice Interviews Discussions in Technical Groups About Selenium Certification & Placement Course in Pune The 3RI Technologies Selenium Certification and the Selenium Course with Placement cover a significant amount of ground within their respective scopes.Because of how the course is structured, it can cover various assessment methods and tools. Here is a rundown of all of them for your convenience: Unix, C, C++, and Data Structures SQL Essentials of Core Java Software Engineering Fundamentals Testing by hand Selenium Certification covers Selenium, TestLink, QTP, Mantis, and Jmeter. How Can Selenium Training in Pune Help Advance Your Testing Career? Open-Source and Cost-effective: Since Selenium is an open-source automation testing tool, there are no license fees associated with its use. In addition to the technology, testers have access to a wealth of documentation and community resources to aid in their implementation and learning. Supports Multiple Programming Languages: Selenium allows testers to work with programming languages they are comfortable with, including Java, Python, C#, JavaScript, Ruby, and PHP. This flexibility makes it easier to integrate automation into different development and testing environments. Reusable Automation Scripts: With Selenium, testers can create automation scripts that can be executed repeatedly for regression and functional testing. Reusable test scripts help reduce repetitive manual work and make testing more efficient. Cross-Browser and Cross-Platform Testing: Selenium supports popular browsers such as Chrome, Firefox, Edge, and Safari and works across operating systems including Windows, Linux, and macOS. This makes it useful for testing web applications across different environments. Integrates with Testing Tools and Frameworks: Selenium can work alongside popular testing frameworks and development tools such as TestNG, JUnit, Maven, Jenkins, and cloud-based testing platforms. This allows testers to build structured automation workflows and connect testing with CI/CD processes. About Selenium Certification & Job Ready Course in Pune 3RI Technologies’ Selenium Certification and Selenium Course with Placement offers comprehensive coverage of the key topics required for mastering automation testing. Our course is thoughtfully structured to equip candidates with the vital skills and techniques needed for software testing, ensuring alignment with current industry standards. We provide in-depth training in various testing methods and tools, integrated into distinct modules throughout the course. These modules guarantee that students gain a strong understanding of theoretical concepts alongside practical implementation. Below are the core areas covered in our course: Fundamentals of Core Java : Building a solid foundation in Java, which is essential for integrating with Selenium. Manual Testing : Learning the basic principles and processes of manual testing to understand the broader scope of software testing. Automation Testing with Selenium : Comprehensive training on Selenium IDE, WebDriver, Grid , and their applications in real-world testing scenarios. Selenium + Java Integration : Master the combination of Selenium with Java for efficient automation scripting. Other Tools : Exposure to additional testing tools like JMeter and TestLink , which complement the use of Selenium in testing environments. This job-ready course also offers practical experience through live projects and case studies, ensuring that students leave with a skill set that is immediately applicable in the workforce. Whether you are new to automation testing or seeking to upgrade your existing skills, our Selenium Course in Pune will provide you with the expertise and confidence to excel in the field. Job Roles and Responsibilities After a Selenium Course in Pune Some of the many opportunities in the Selenium industry that become accessible after completing the certification course are as follows: Job Role Key Responsibilities Automation Test Engineer Use Selenium to create and manage automated test scripts, run test cases, find bugs, and verify application functionality. Selenium Tester Develop Selenium WebDriver scripts, perform functional and regression testing, and report bugs to development teams. QA Automation Engineer Design automation test cases, maintain testing frameworks, execute automated test suites, and improve overall test coverage. Software Test Engineer Perform functional, regression, integration, and cross-browser testing while documenting and tracking defects. Test Automation Engineer Build reusable automation scripts, integrate tests with CI/CD pipelines, and monitor automated test execution. QA Engineer Recognise the needs of the application, create test scenarios, run both automated and manual tests, and guarantee software quality. Automation QA Engineer Combine testing knowledge with automation skills to develop test scripts, analyze failures, and collaborate with developers to resolve defects. Junior Automation Tester Assist with test case creation, execute Selenium scripts, document issues, and support senior QA professionals with automation activities.
